# mamma-capture
Multi-view body capture: track every person in the cameras, find their dense 2D landmarks, triangulate them and fit an SMPL-X body to each person over a sliding window of frames.

**Read the picture top to bottom.** A box is one step: its number and name, what it does, how it runs (blue = source, orange = once per item, purple = once on the whole segment, green = output; while a run is live: grey = no input yet, green = ok, yellow = its queue is half full, red = it dropped items). A label on a line is the data that flows, `port: Type`, and how it arrives:
- **waits**: every item, in order; the sender waits while the queue is full (nothing is lost)
- **latest**: the newest value at or before the step's time; it never starts the step
- **drops old**: only the newest items; older ones are dropped while the step is busy

`(GPU)` after a type: the value stays on the GPU. A tag left of a box lists its inputs from further up (`port: Type ← 1 video · latest`). Box numbers match the sections below.

## 1 · video: Decode the cameras' videos
*source* · `CatalogVideoSource` · `packages/simplecv/simplecv/sources/catalog_video.py`

Decoded framesets after STATIC ``rig`` (base-layer calibration at stored size, when all cameras have it) and ``statics``. Temporal statics are read whole. RGB frames are index-aligned at sampled indices, timed by the first camera: ``nvdec_rgb`` emits ``Fenced[MultiViewFrames]``; ``cpu_rgb`` emits ``MultiViewFrames``. ``resize_hw`` applies area resize; ``keep_native`` emits ``frames_native`` just before ``frames`` at the same time. ``cpu_luma`` emits ``LumaFrameset`` for every frame in the window, grouped by ``group_tolerance_ns`` and timed by its opening. ``undistort`` (``cpu_rgb``): every frame is remapped with its camera's stored coefficients (``undistortion_maps``) and the rig carries the undistorted pinhole.

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **frames** | `MultiViewFrames` (GPU) | 2 track |
| **frames_native** | `MultiViewFrames` (GPU) | 3 landmarks |
| **rig** | `RigCameras` | 2 track, 4 fit |

## 2 · track: Track every person in every view
*runs once per item* · `TrackNode` · `packages/mamma/src/mamma/nodes/track.py`

Masks and boxes per (view, person) at engine size; a person keeps one id across views and time (CLIP + epipolar identity at bootstrap and re-detects, SAM2 masks every tick).

| takes | type | from | arrives |
|---|---|---|---|
| **frames** | `MultiViewFrames` (GPU) | 1 video | waits (2) |
| **rig** | `RigCameras` | 1 video | latest |

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **tracks** | `MultiViewTracks` (GPU) | 3 landmarks, 5 viewer, 6 mamma_fit |

Settings:
- `sam2_config`: Hydra config inside the vendored sam2 package (EfficientTAM-ti: 21.8 ms per 4-view tick vs 52.6 for hiera-small)
- `sam2_checkpoint`
- `yolo_checkpoint`
- `memory_window_size`: Non-conditional SAM2 memories kept per object
- `expected_subjects`: People to track; None = as many as the bootstrap view detects
- +6 more

## 3 · landmarks: Find each tracked person's 2D landmarks
*runs once per item* · `LandmarksNode` · `packages/mamma/src/mamma/nodes/landmarks.py`

MammaNet's dense landmarks (with log-variance, visibility and floor contact) per (view, person) track, cropped around the track's mask from the frames of the same tick.

| takes | type | from | arrives |
|---|---|---|---|
| **tracks** | `MultiViewTracks` (GPU) | 2 track | waits (2) |
| **frames** | `MultiViewFrames` (GPU) | 1 video | latest |

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **landmarks** | `MultiViewLandmarks` (GPU) | 4 fit, 5 viewer |

## 4 · fit: Fit an SMPL-X body to each person
*runs once per item* · `FitNode` · `packages/mamma/src/mamma/nodes/fit.py`

Triangulates every person's landmarks across the views, then fits SMPL-X over a sliding window per person; a fit comes out ``emit_lag`` ticks late, in time order.

| takes | type | from | arrives |
|---|---|---|---|
| **landmarks** | `MultiViewLandmarks` (GPU) | 3 landmarks | waits (4) |
| **rig** | `RigCameras` | 1 video | latest |

| gives | type | to |
|---|---|---|
| **fit** | `SmplxFits` | 5 viewer, 6 mamma_fit |
| **kp3d** | `Landmarks3d` | 5 viewer, 6 mamma_fit |
| **topology** | `BodyTopology` | 5 viewer, 6 mamma_fit |

Settings:
- `window_size`: Frames kept in the optimization window
- `bootstrap_iters`: Adam iterations for the first-window solve (betas optimized here)
- `tick_iters`: Adam iterations per optimize tick (betas frozen; graph replays are ~1 ms/iter so the default 48 costs ~48 ms on the overlapped fit worker)
- `learning_rate`: Adam learning rate (0.03 oscillates, 0.01 under-converges at this budget)
- `fit_stride`: Optimize every Nth tick; skipped ticks emit the warm-started forward of the previous solution (observations still enter the window)
- +16 more

## 5 · viewer: Draw its inputs in the viewer
*output* · `RerunSink` · `packages/dagkit/dagkit/sinks.py`

Takes **tracks** from 2 track; **landmarks** from 3 landmarks; **fit, kp3d, topology** from 4 fit.

## 6 · mamma_fit: Save its inputs as a catalog layer
*output* · `LayerSink` · `packages/dagkit/dagkit/sinks.py`

Saves **tracks** from 2 track; **fit, kp3d, topology** from 4 fit into the catalog layer `mamma_fit`.

## Data types
| type | what it is | code |
|---|---|---|
| `BodyTopology` | The SMPL-X triangle list, sent once per person when its fit starts (the fits carry only vertices) | `packages/mamma/src/mamma/types.py` |
| `Landmarks3d` | Triangulated dense landmarks of one tick per person; invalid points are 0 (SPEC 5.2 policy) | `packages/mamma/src/mamma/types.py` |
| `MultiViewFrames` | One synchronized sample of every camera; a single camera is ``v == 1`` | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/frames.py` |
| `MultiViewLandmarks` | MammaNet's dense landmarks of one frameset, one row per (view, person) track, in engine pixels | `packages/mamma/src/mamma/types.py` |
| `MultiViewTracks` | Person masks of one frameset at engine size, one row per (view, person) track | `packages/mamma/src/mamma/types.py` |
| `RigCameras` | Per camera, in ``names`` order: pinhole intrinsics, world-to-camera pose (RDF, metric) and image size | `packages/simplecv/simplecv/types/rig.py` |
| `SmplxFits` | SMPL-X fits (neutral body, 16 betas) of the persons fitted at one frame time; world metres, z up | `packages/mamma/src/mamma/types.py` |
